title: AUDIT.redactions (audit.redactions.v1)
description: Story 3.1 append-only SIEM projection of a single redacted field (FR41/FR44). AUTHORITATIVE validation source for AUDIT.redactions; redactions.yaml is the human-readable mirror. Records that a field at field_path was redacted for reason, NEVER the secret value that was redacted (NFR18). redacted_at (the redaction decision time) is distinct from published_at (the audit-emission time).
